hypothesis_source: Inside-bar then break still lost to same-day untriggered leaders (10/20-day spread -0.34%/-0.53%). The compression step may be the same rest-then-pop as the 20-bar cooldown. Replacement: close above the prior session high, no inside-bar filter. Mechanism: take out yesterday, not take out a compressed bar.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a 20-day high. Not VCP. Not all-market trend_breakout. Difference from inside-bar v1: drop the inside-bar requirement. Difference from 20d highs: the hurdle is one session, not a month range.

trigger.definition: Causal close[t] > high[t-1] on the market calendar. Missing prior high does not trigger.

selected: Watch list AND close above prior session high.
control: Same-day watch-list names whose close did not exceed the prior session high.

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of the trigger subset is not worse than same-day watch names without the trigger.
pass_fail.fail: Stop taking-out-a-high as the layer-3 selector on this watch list. Next layer-3 event must not be another Donchian/high-takeout. Do not add VCP. Pullback may then be tested as the remaining trigger, because breakout-through-high has been the event under test and failed.
